title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G027
note: Single-case regression for completed-order unit aggregation and the completed_units output alias.

cases.question: How many units were included in completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS completed_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';
